correctness.rationale: The Fraisse extension property for three independently amalgamated finite linear orders proves the gap-type enumeration. Feasible incomparability fails exactly at strict coordinatewise dominance in either direction. The exact matrix is J-U tensor cube-(U transpose) tensor cube. For n=1,2,3 complete unimodular elementary-operation certificates, replayed from the actual packaged bytes, prove Smith factors respectively 1^3, 1^15 and 2, 1^44 and 3 with stated free nullities. Modular ranks are cross-checks, not used in place of the integral proof. The trivial n=0 case and finite n<3 cases establish the sharp onset, and no unproved large-n inference is made.

originality.rationale: The claim is not the Fraisse construction or a two-order count: it is the exact integral Smith form for the existential comparability matrix on three-order pointwise-named gap types, with the first odd-primary torsion at three parameters. Cameron provides the homogeneous multiorder context, Braunfeld discusses general three-order homogeneous structures, and a known two-order compatibility matrix has only a parity-dependent two-primary phenomenon. The exact three-order matrices and their explicit integer reductions were compared against searchable published-finding corpus records and targeted product-poset/Smith literature; no equivalent theorem was located. Priority remains provisional because a different naming of the same finite product-grid matrix could hide a prior computation.
residual_risks: Equivalent strict product-grid matrix may be embedded in unindexed integer graph-matrix literature.
Only the recorded relevant sections of Cameron and Braunfeld were materially inspected; some other plausible source full texts were not comprehensively reviewed.
Results for n >=4 are not claimed; cutoff is limited to the first odd torsion threshold.

value.rationale: The existential pair-type incomparability matrix is a natural invariant of the generic three-order structure. The exact first odd-characteristic drop is structurally motivated by comparing the two-order two-primary parity phenomenon with the genuinely three-coordinate situation. The minimal three-parameter cutoff and a complete primitive integral presentation are substantive arithmetic information not implied by a scalar type count or routine enumeration. The claim is narrow but a complete first-occurrence classification rather than an arbitrary numerical sample.
